notes.title: Signal Intentions V1.0.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Achievement unlock not triggering

Players, unfortunately, will have to complete each mode again to unlock each achievement for completing each mode

For the all anomalies completed achievement, if player has already completed all anomalies, the achievement should auto unlock at game launch

Lighting issue caused by one anomaly in meeting room

Fix bug where hover / interaction text sometimes shows no translation message available when loading into the game

notes.title: Signal Intentions Full Release
notes.content:
Features
Three modes of anomaly spotting

53 Anomalies split among the three modes

Localisation available for

Simplified Chinese

Japanese

Portuguese – Brazilian

Partial Controller Support

Menu navigation using controller not fully supported at the moment
Post-Launch Plan
As the game moves into post launch, the focus will shift into:

Bug fixing

Fixing any performance issues

So do send in any issues you face while launching or playing the game! As for content updates, I might do some free updates in the future in line with seasonal events such as Halloween. I might even do a VR version, if I have the time to do so.


Hope you all have some fun spotting the anomalies!

notes.title: Signal Intentions v0.2.1 - Demo Update Available Now!
notes.content:
Signal Intentions v0.2.1
Hey all,

As the development reaches the final stages, more updates to the demo has been added. Starting from this update, all patch notes will also be released here in the community hub to keep players updated! Final release date will be updated in the upcoming weeks, so stay tune!

In the meantime, do leave some feedbacks, and bug reports through the form linked in the main menu, the community hub, or simply email to play@headphoneturtlegames.com :)


Summary
UI updates to chapter select

Tab menu instead of a scroll view

Added 5 more anomalies to demo chapter

Demo chapter updates 

Reduce to 8 levels for demo chapter

Added option to reset level to allow players to try to get all anomalies completed.

Bug fixes

Interaction text not appearing some times

Settings and pause menu screen overlaps

Chapter select shows incorrect completion rate
